name: ${localWorkspaceFolderBasename} (dev)

sudo chown vscode:vscode frontend/node_modules && echo '

========================================
Welcome to Rule Builder Dev Container!

  ./scripts/install.sh

To start the frontend (port 3003):
  ./scripts/start-frontend.sh

For more information, see README.md
========================================

'
